description: This file contains unit tests for version parsing and comparison functions related to the OpenClaw software versions. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify correct behavior of version parsing, comparison, and family grouping logic.

methods.name: parseOpenClawVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into its components including major, minor, patch, revision, and prerelease info.

methods.name: compareOpenClawVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine which is newer, according to OpenClaw version semantics.

methods.name: isSameOpenClawStableFamily
methods.description: Determines if two version strings belong to the same stable release family.

methods.name: shouldWarnOnTouchedVersion
methods.description: Decides whether a warning should be issued when a version is 'touched' or modified.
